name: Ferrara, City of the Renaissance, and its Po Delta
description: Ferrara is a Renaissance city in Emilia-Romagna, northern Italy, about 44 km northeast of Bologna and a short distance from the Po. In the 15th and 16th centuries the Este dukes brought painters such as Piero della Francesca and Mantegna to decorate their palaces. From 1492 architect Biagio Rossetti added broad, planned streets that made it an early model of modern town planning.
